messages:
lina: starting a blue/green for router-batcher v0.9.1 in the 75m change window (2026-03-22T09:00Z->2026-03-22T10:15Z). plan: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. soft-drain old pods during each step. runbook: https://runbook.internal/router-batcher-bluegreen

deploy-bot: PRECHECK OK. staging smoke green. initiating 2% canary now.

ops-oncall: watchlist: backend-p95, p99, 5xx, inflight-reqs, warmup_kv_hits. rollback thresholds: p95>260ms for 3m OR 5xx>1.5% sustained 2m OR inflight-reqs > 1500 -> immediate rollback to v0.9.0.

tom: note — batch window jobs run every 5m. ensure we don't overlap heavy batch jobs during ramp steps. I've paused non-critical batch schedules for next 20m.

sara: can we keep session-affinity off for this service? affinity causes skew with batch routing.

lina: yes we'll disable affinity for the migration window. ops-oncall: applying cookie off.

ops-oncall: affinity disabled. starting 10% step in 8m unless warmup fails.

deploy-bot: moving to 10% now. applying soft-drain on old pods: `kubectl label pods -l app=router-batcher team=drain` then scale-up new replica set.

sara: quick smoke at 10% passed. small p99 blip in ap-south but recovered. no user errors.

tom: batch-job overlap avoided. queue-length stable.

deploy-bot: preparing 40% ramp. running warmup probe to check kv hit-rate:
```
curl -sS "https://orchestrator.internal/metrics?service=router-batcher&metric=warmup_kv_hits" | jq '.value'
```
current value 0.93 -> warmup OK.

ops-oncall: metrics now: p95=190ms, p99=420ms (brief), 5xx=0.4%, inflight-reqs=820, warmup_kv_hits=93%. proceeding to 40%.

lina: reminder to update release notes with soft-drain guidance and batch scheduling note.

deploy-bot: ramped to 40%. doing post-step smoke.

sara: post-40% smoke good. observed one retry spike tied to downstream svc-c during a short GC. not in rollback zone.

ops-oncall: observed transient p99 spike to 700ms for 40s at 40% but 5xx stayed below threshold. continue to 100% with 15m quiet window.

deploy-bot: final shift to 100% starting. applying soft-evac and scaling down old RS gracefully.

release-notes-bot: Draft published -> https://docs.internal/releases/router-batcher-v0.9.1 (notes: soft-drain behavior, disabled affinity, batch window pause, kv warmup requirement).

lina: once stable, please pin in /traffic/pins and re-enable batch schedule jobs after 30m. thanks all.

ops-oncall: watch window until 10:45Z. no alerts so far.

deploy-bot: complete at 2026-03-22T09:31:40Z. smoke=e2e pass. :tada:
